description: The price and billing terms of a rental before it is made, from the live nodes feed: GPU, count, USD per GPU-hour and per hour, and when billing starts and stops. Rents nothing. Returns quote_id, which rent_pod requires with the same arguments (valid 30 to 60 minutes).

count.description: GPUs on one node (default: 1 with gpu, every free GPU with node_id)

country.description: Two-letter country code (with gpu, not node_id)

gpu.description: GPU model, e.g. H100, RTX 4090; quotes the cheapest node that fits

max_price_per_gpu_hour.description: Price cap in USD per GPU-hour (with gpu, not node_id)

node_id.description: A node id from search_gpus, to quote that node

template_id.description: From list_templates; default: Lium's default image for the node

name: quote_rent
title: Quote a Lium GPU rental
